channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: How to Track a Transaction on LayerZero Scan from Send to Delivery
item.description: Track a transaction on LayerZero Scan by searching its source hash or sender address, then follow the message status and destination hash to delivery.

item.title: How to Go From Wallet Setup to a Filled Order
item.description: Cowswap guide: connect a wallet, approve a sell token, sign the order, then verify its filled status and received amount by order ID in CoW Explorer.

item.title: Why Did I Pay Gas Twice Bridging an ERC-20?
item.description: Why did I pay gas twice when bridging an ERC-20 token? One charge may approve spending; the next deposits tokens, with each transaction using ETH for gas.

item.title: Why Does a Token Price Fall With Liquidity Locked?
item.description: Why does a token price fall even when liquidity is locked? A lock restricts withdrawals; selling, weaker demand and falling SOL can still lower its dollar price.

item.title: DOJ wins authority over $1.2 billion in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department won authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion theft, while recovery and forfeiture remain ongoing.

item.title: Network directory websites: Can they access wallet funds?
item.description: Can a network directory website access my wallet funds? No: connecting shares your public address, and adding a network saves settings; signing is what can authorize fund movement.

item.title: How to trace an unknown token approval to its first grant
item.description: Find an unknown token approval's transaction by matching chain, token, owner and spender to Approval events, then inspect receipts to identify its first grant.

item.title: US moves to seize $1.2bn of crypto stolen from Binance
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, while over $2.7 billion is frozen.

item.title: US gets authority to seize $1.2bn from Binance hack
item.description: US courts authorized seizure or restraint of $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6 billion hack, part of more than $2.7 billion frozen since the October theft.

item.title: How a Decentralized Exchange Works: From Wallet to Swap
item.description: What is a decentralized exchange and how does it work? A DEX trades tokens from your wallet against a smart-contract pool, with fees and gas to review.

item.title: TRON DEX swap confirmation: inclusion and solidification
item.description: How long does a TRON DEX swap take to confirm? Usually seconds for block inclusion and about a minute for the transaction to become irreversible.

item.title: How to Use cBridge to Move Tokens to Another Chain
item.description: How to use cBridge: connect a wallet, choose chains and token, approve and send, then confirm the destination balance. Keep gas ready and test small first.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: A US court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack proceeds, within $2.7 billion frozen as tracing efforts continue.

item.title: US courts authorize action on $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US courts authorized seizure or restraint of $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, while authorities and private firms have frozen more than $2.7 billion.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says court orders cover more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far as recovery and forfeiture continue.

item.title: US secures authority over $1.2 billion in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion, part of $2.7 billion frozen after Binance’s October theft.

item.title: US targets $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance
item.description: The Justice Department says court orders cover more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, within $2.7 billion frozen so far, as tracing continues.

item.title: US Wins Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Stolen Crypto
item.description: The DOJ says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion of Binance’s stolen crypto, part of a wider freeze that still faces forfeiture proceedings.

item.title: Zcash vote weighs 50,000 ZEC grants-treasury removal
item.description: Zcash’s Nov. 16–30 polls will weigh a draft to remove 50,000 ZEC from grants and redirect future funding, shifting support toward miners and a locked fund.

item.title: Visa adds Monad to its stablecoin settlement network
item.description: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, widening its network menu as institutional privacy tools remain in development.
